description:
## Goal

Implement `Filament.Test.LiveView` — a thin wrapper around `Phoenix.LiveViewTest` for
full end-to-end integration tests of Filament components running inside a real LiveView.
Rung 4 uses a WebSocket-connected LiveView, real Endpoint, real observable GenServers.

This module adds convenience helpers on top of `Phoenix.LiveViewTest` and provides a
`use Filament.Test.LiveView` macro that sets up the required imports.

## Deviation policy

Any deviation from this spec requires prior approval. Stop work, run
`bw comment <ticket-id> "..."` describing the conflict, reopen the ticket, and await
guidance. Do not improvise.

---

## Prerequisite

F1 merged (Filament.Test must exist).
Track B B7 merged (Filament.LiveView adapter — the host LiveView for components).

---

## Background: Phoenix.LiveViewTest API

The relevant Phoenix.LiveViewTest functions are:
- `live/2` — connect to a LiveView, returns `{:ok, view, html}`
- `element/2` — returns a selector struct for a live view element
- `render_click/1` — click an element
- `render_submit/2` — submit a form with params
- `render/1` — get current rendered HTML as string

These are imported by `use Phoenix.LiveViewTest`. The Filament wrapper adds helpers
on top of these — it does NOT reimplement them.

---

## 1. Filament.Test.LiveView module

FILE: test/support/filament_test_live_view.ex
(or follow the project's test support path convention)

```elixir
defmodule Filament.Test.LiveView do
  @moduledoc """
  Rung 4 test helpers for Filament components running in a full LiveView.

  Usage in a test module:

      defmodule MyFeatureTest do
        use Filament.Test.LiveView, endpoint: MyApp.Endpoint
      end

  This brings in Phoenix.LiveViewTest, ExUnit.Case, and the helpers below.
  """

  defmacro __using__(opts) do
    quote do
      use ExUnit.Case, async: false  # LiveView tests are generally not async
      use Phoenix.LiveViewTest

      import Filament.Test.LiveView.Helpers

      setup do
        # Ensure the endpoint is started. Tests using this macro must configure
        # their endpoint in test_helper.exs. This is a guard, not a start call.
        endpoint = unquote(opts[:endpoint])
        unless endpoint, do: raise("Filament.Test.LiveView requires endpoint: MyApp.Endpoint")
        :ok
      end
    end
  end
end
```

---

## 2. Filament.Test.LiveView.Helpers module

FILE: test/support/filament_test_live_view_helpers.ex
(or a submodule of Filament.Test.LiveView — follow project convention)

```elixir
defmodule Filament.Test.LiveView.Helpers do
  @moduledoc """
  Helper functions for Rung 4 integration tests.

  These wrap Phoenix.LiveViewTest functions with Filament-specific conventions.
  Import via `use Filament.Test.LiveView`.
  """

  import Phoenix.LiveViewTest

  @doc """
  Click the element matching `selector` in a live view.
  Wraps Phoenix.LiveViewTest.element/2 + render_click/1.
  Returns the updated rendered HTML string.
  """
  @spec filament_click(view :: Phoenix.LiveViewTest.View.t(), selector :: String.t()) ::
          String.t()
  def filament_click(view, selector) do
    view |> element(selector) |> render_click()
  end

  @doc """
  Submit the form matching `selector` with `params`.
  Wraps Phoenix.LiveViewTest.element/2 + render_submit/2.
  Returns the updated rendered HTML string.
  """
  @spec filament_submit(
          view :: Phoenix.LiveViewTest.View.t(),
          selector :: String.t(),
          params :: map()
        ) :: String.t()
  def filament_submit(view, selector, params \\ %{}) do
    view |> element(selector) |> render_submit(params)
  end

  @doc """
  Return the current rendered text content (tags stripped) for the live view.
  """
  @spec filament_text(view :: Phoenix.LiveViewTest.View.t()) :: String.t()
  def filament_text(view) do
    view
    |> render()
    |> Floki.parse_fragment!()
    |> Floki.text()
    |> String.trim()
  end

  @doc """
  Assert that `selector` element has CSS class `class_name` in the current render.
  Raises ExUnit.AssertionError with a descriptive message on failure.
  """
  @spec assert_has_class(
          view :: Phoenix.LiveViewTest.View.t(),
          selector :: String.t(),
          class_name :: String.t()
        ) :: :ok
  def assert_has_class(view, selector, class_name) do
    html = render(view)
    elements = html |> Floki.parse_fragment!() |> Floki.find(selector)

    case elements do
      [] ->
        raise ExUnit.AssertionError,
          message: "assert_has_class: no element matched #{inspect(selector)}"

      elements ->
        has_it =
          Enum.any?(elements, fn el ->
            classes =
              Floki.attribute(el, "class")
              |> List.first("")
              |> String.split(~r/\s+/, trim: true)

            class_name in classes
          end)

        unless has_it do
          raise ExUnit.AssertionError,
            message:
              "assert_has_class: expected #{inspect(selector)} to have class " <>
                inspect(class_name) <> " but it did not.\nRendered:\n#{html}"
        end

        :ok
    end
  end
end
```

## 3. Tests

FILE: test/filament/test/rung4_test.exs

Rung 4 tests require a running endpoint. Without Track G (examples) providing a real
Phoenix app, write a minimal self-contained test setup:

```elixir
defmodule Filament.Test.Rung4Test do
  # NOTE: This test requires a minimal Phoenix endpoint to be configured.
  # If no test endpoint exists in this project yet (pre-Track G), this test
  # file should be written but marked @moduletag :pending so it does not
  # run in CI until the endpoint is available.
  # DO NOT skip the file — write it, tag it :pending, and document what
  # endpoint configuration is needed.
  use ExUnit.Case
  @moduletag :pending

  @moduledoc """
  Rung 4 integration tests. Currently pending — requires a Phoenix test
  endpoint (provided by Track G examples or Track I integration setup).

  When the endpoint is available, update the @moduletag and add:
    use Filament.Test.LiveView, endpoint: MyApp.Endpoint
  """

  test "placeholder — rung 4 requires endpoint (Track G/I)" do
    # This test intentionally passes to confirm the module compiles.
    assert true
  end
end
```

The substantive Rung 4 tests live in Track H (test suite) where they import Track G examples.
This ticket's job is to deliver the module and API, not the full test suite.

Run: `mix test test/filament/test/rung4_test.exs`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `Filament.Test.LiveView` module compiles with `use Filament.Test.LiveView, endpoint: _`
- [ ] `Filament.Test.LiveView.Helpers` compiles and exports `filament_click/2`,
      `filament_submit/3`, `filament_text/1`, `assert_has_class/3`
- [ ] `rung4_test.exs` exists, compiles, and the placeholder test passes
- [ ] Dialyzer clean
- [ ] F1 + F2 tests still pass
